s.plain: My name is Emily.
s.kana: My name is Emily.

s.plain: I get up at seven o'clock every day.
s.kana: I get up at seven o'clock every day.

t: In the morning, I eat bread and drink milk.
s.plain: In the morning, I eat bread and drink milk.
s.kana: In the morning, I eat bread and drink milk.

paragraphs.zh: 我叫艾蜜莉。我每天七點起床。早上吃麵包、喝牛奶。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我叫艾蜜莉。我每天七点起床。早上吃面包、喝牛奶。

s.plain: At eight, I leave home.
s.kana: At eight, I leave home.

s.plain: I take the subway to school.
s.kana: I take the subway to school.

s.plain: At school, I study Japanese with my friends.
s.kana: At school, I study Japanese with my friends.

paragraphs.zh: 八點出門。搭捷運去學校。在學校和朋友們一起學日文。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 八点出门。搭捷运去学校。在学校和朋友们一起学日文。

t: At noon, I eat lunch with a friend in the
s.plain: At noon, I eat lunch with a friend in the cafeteria.
s.kana: At noon, I eat lunch with a friend in the cafeteria.

t: In the afternoon, I read in the
s.plain: In the afternoon, I read in the library.
s.kana: In the afternoon, I read in the library.

paragraphs.zh: 中午和一個朋友在學校餐廳吃午餐。下午在圖書館看書。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 中午和一个朋友在学校餐厅吃午餐。下午在图书馆看书。

s.plain: In the evening, I cook dinner at home.
s.kana: In the evening, I cook dinner at home.

s.plain: Then I watch TV and go to bed at eleven.
s.kana: Then I watch TV and go to bed at eleven.

paragraphs.zh: 晚上在家做晚餐。然後看電視，十一點睡覺。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 晚上在家做晚餐。然后看电视，十一点睡觉。

glossary.en: a place at school or work to eat
a place where you read or borrow books
to go to sleep at night

q: What time does Emily get up?
mcq.zh: 「I get up at seven o'clock」：七點起床。八點是出門的時間。
mcq.en: “I get up at seven o'clock” — at seven. Eight is when she leaves.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I get up at seven o'clock」：七点起床。八点是出门的时间。

q: How does she go to school?
mcq.zh: 「I take the subway to school」：搭捷運。
mcq.en: “I take the subway to school” — by subway.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I take the subway to school」：搭捷运。

q: Where does she eat lunch?
mcq.zh: 「I eat lunch with a friend in the cafeteria」：在學校餐廳。
mcq.en: “I eat lunch with a friend in the cafeteria” — in the cafeteria.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I eat lunch with a friend in the cafeteria」：在学校餐厅。

q: What does she do in the afternoon?
mcq.zh: 「In the afternoon, I read in the library」：下午看書。看電視和做晚餐是晚上。
mcq.en: “In the afternoon, I read in the library” — she reads. TV and dinner are in the evening.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「In the afternoon, I read in the library」：下午看书。看电视和做晚餐是晚上。

q: What time does she go to bed?
mcq.zh: 「go to bed at eleven」：十一點睡覺。
mcq.en: “go to bed at eleven” — at eleven.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「go to bed at eleven」：十一点睡觉。

s: In the morning, Emily eats rice.
tf.zh: ×：早上吃的是「bread」（麵包）。
tf.en: False: in the morning she eats bread.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：早上吃的是「bread」（面包）。

s: At school, she studies Japanese with her friends.
tf.zh: ○：「At school, I study Japanese with my friends」。
tf.en: True: At school, I study Japanese with my friends.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「At school, I study Japanese with my friends」。

s: In the evening, she eats at a restaurant.
tf.zh: ×：晚上「I cook dinner at home」，在家自己做。
tf.en: False: she cooks dinner at home.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：晚上「I cook dinner at home」，在家自己做。

t: On Sunday, I went to a new café
s.plain: On Sunday, I went to a new café near the station with my friend Amy.
s.kana: On Sunday, I went to a new café near the station with my friend Amy.

paragraphs.zh: 星期天，我和朋友艾美一起去了車站附近一家新的咖啡廳。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 星期天，我和朋友艾美一起去了车站附近一家新的咖啡厅。

t: The café is very pretty, and there are
s.plain: The café is very pretty, and there are a lot of people.
s.kana: The café is very pretty, and there are a lot of people.

t: I had a coffee and a piece of chocolate
s.plain: I had a coffee and a piece of chocolate cake.
s.kana: I had a coffee and a piece of chocolate cake.

s.plain: Amy drank green tea.
s.kana: Amy drank green tea.

paragraphs.zh: 咖啡廳很漂亮，人很多。我點了一杯咖啡和一塊巧克力蛋糕。艾美喝了綠茶。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 咖啡厅很漂亮，人很多。我点了一杯咖啡和一块巧克力蛋糕。艾美喝了绿茶。

s.plain: The cake is a little expensive, but it is very good.
s.kana: The cake is a little expensive, but it is very good.

s.plain: We talked for two hours.
s.kana: We talked for two hours.

paragraphs.zh: 蛋糕有點貴，但是非常好吃。我們聊了兩個小時。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 蛋糕有点贵，但是非常好吃。我们聊了两个小时。

t: , I am going to go there again with my sister.
s.plain: Next week, I am going to go there again with my sister.
s.kana: Next week, I am going to go there again with my sister.

paragraphs.zh: 下個星期，我要和姊姊再去一次。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 下个星期，我要和姊姊再去一次。

glossary.en: to take water, tea, etc. into your mouth

q: When did they go to the café?
mcq.zh: 「On Sunday, I went to a new café」：星期天。
mcq.en: “On Sunday, I went to a new café” — on Sunday.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「On Sunday, I went to a new café」：星期天。

q: Where is the café?
mcq.zh: 「a new café near the station」：在車站附近。
mcq.en: “a new café near the station” — near the station.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「a new café near the station」：在车站附近。

q: What did Amy drink?
mcq.zh: 「Amy drank green tea」：綠茶。咖啡是「我」點的。
mcq.en: “Amy drank green tea” — green tea. The coffee was the writer's.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「Amy drank green tea」：绿茶。咖啡是「我」点的。

q: What is the cake like?
options: A little expensive, but very good
mcq.zh: 「The cake is a little expensive, but it is very good」：有點貴但很好吃。
mcq.en: “The cake is a little expensive, but it is very good.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「The cake is a little expensive, but it is very good」：有点贵但很好吃。

q: Who is she going to go there with next week?
mcq.zh: 「I am going to go there again with my sister」：和姊姊一起。
mcq.en: “I am going to go there again with my sister” — her sister.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I am going to go there again with my sister」：和姊姊一起。

s: There are not many people in the café.
tf.zh: ×：「there are a lot of people」，人很多。
tf.en: False: there are a lot of people.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「there are a lot of people」，人很多。

s: They talked for two hours.
tf.zh: ○：「We talked for two hours」。
tf.en: True: We talked for two hours.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「We talked for two hours」。

s: She had strawberry cake.
tf.zh: ×：她點的是「chocolate cake」（巧克力蛋糕）。
tf.en: False: she had chocolate cake.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：她点的是「chocolate cake」（巧克力蛋糕）。

s.plain: My name is Ben.
s.kana: My name is Ben.

t: This Saturday, I am going to go to the
s.plain: This Saturday, I am going to go to the beach with my family.
s.kana: This Saturday, I am going to go to the beach with my family.

paragraphs.zh: 我叫班。這個星期六，我要和家人去海邊。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我叫班。这个星期六，我要和家人去海边。

s.plain: We are going to leave at nine in the morning.
s.kana: We are going to leave at nine in the morning.

t: We are going to take the
s.plain: We are going to take the train.
s.kana: We are going to take the train.

s.plain: The trip takes two hours.
s.kana: The trip takes two hours.

paragraphs.zh: 我們早上九點出發。我們要搭火車。路程要兩個小時。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我们早上九点出发。我们要搭火车。路程要两个小时。

t: , my brother and I are going to
s.plain: At the beach, my brother and I are going to swim in the sea.
s.kana: At the beach, my brother and I are going to swim in the sea.

s.plain: My parents are going to take a walk on the beach.
s.kana: My parents are going to take a walk on the beach.

paragraphs.zh: 到了海邊，我和哥哥要去海裡游泳。爸爸媽媽要在沙灘上散步。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 到了海边，我和哥哥要去海里游泳。爸爸妈妈要在沙滩上散步。

t: In the evening, we are going to eat
s.plain: In the evening, we are going to eat fish at a small restaurant.
s.kana: In the evening, we are going to eat fish at a small restaurant.

s.plain: I am so happy!
s.kana: I am so happy!

paragraphs.zh: 晚上我們要在一家小餐廳吃魚。我好開心！
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 晚上我们要在一家小餐厅吃鱼。我好开心！

glossary.en: to go away from a place
a vehicle that runs on a railway
an animal that lives in water; its meat

q: Where is Ben going to go on Saturday?
mcq.zh: 「I am going to go to the beach」：去海邊。
mcq.en: “I am going to go to the beach” — the beach.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I am going to go to the beach」：去海边。

q: What time are they going to leave?
mcq.zh: 「We are going to leave at nine in the morning」：早上九點。兩個小時是路程的時間。
mcq.en: “We are going to leave at nine in the morning” — at nine. Two hours is how long the trip takes.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「We are going to leave at nine in the morning」：早上九点。两个小时是路程的时间。

q: How are they going to travel?
mcq.zh: 「We are going to take the train」：搭火車。
mcq.en: “We are going to take the train” — by train.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「We are going to take the train」：搭火车。

q: What are his parents going to do?
options: Take a walk on the beach
mcq.zh: 「My parents are going to take a walk on the beach」：在沙灘上散步。游泳的是班和哥哥。
mcq.en: “My parents are going to take a walk on the beach.” Ben and his brother swim.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「My parents are going to take a walk on the beach」：在沙滩上散步。游泳的是班和哥哥。

q: What are they going to eat in the evening?
mcq.zh: 「we are going to eat fish」：吃魚。
mcq.en: “we are going to eat fish” — fish.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「we are going to eat fish」：吃鱼。

s: The trip takes two hours.
tf.zh: ○：「The trip takes two hours」。
tf.en: True: The trip takes two hours.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「The trip takes two hours」。

s: Ben is going to swim with his sister.
tf.zh: ×：他是和「my brother」（哥哥）一起游泳。
tf.en: False: he swims with his brother.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：他是和「my brother」（哥哥）一起游泳。

s: In the evening, they are going to eat at home.
tf.zh: ×：晚上在「a small restaurant」（一家小餐廳）吃。
tf.en: False: they eat at a small restaurant.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：晚上在「a small restaurant」（一家小餐厅）吃。

s.plain: My name is Sam.
s.kana: My name is Sam.

s.plain: Today it is raining hard, and it is cold.
s.kana: Today it is raining hard, and it is cold.

paragraphs.zh: 我叫山姆。今天雨下得很大，而且很冷。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我叫山姆。今天雨下得很大，而且很冷。

t: I am not going to the park with my dog.
s.plain: I am not going to the park with my dog.
s.kana: I am not going to the park with my dog.

s.plain: I am staying at home.
s.kana: I am staying at home.

paragraphs.zh: 我不帶狗去公園了。我待在家裡。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我不带狗去公园了。我待在家里。

t: I am making a cake with my mom.
s.plain: I am making a cake with my mom.
s.kana: I am making a cake with my mom.

t: After that, I am going to read a book and
s.plain: After that, I am going to read a book and listen to music.
s.kana: After that, I am going to read a book and listen to music.

paragraphs.zh: 我正在和媽媽一起做蛋糕。之後要看書、聽音樂。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我正在和妈妈一起做蛋糕。之后要看书、听音乐。

s.plain: My dog is sleeping on the sofa.
s.kana: My dog is sleeping on the sofa.

t: the weather is going to be nice.
s.plain: Tomorrow the weather is going to be nice.
s.kana: Tomorrow the weather is going to be nice.

t: We are going to go to the park!
s.plain: We are going to go to the park!
s.kana: We are going to go to the park!

paragraphs.zh: 我的狗在沙發上睡覺。明天會是好天氣。我們要去公園！
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我的狗在沙发上睡觉。明天会是好天气。我们要去公园！

glossary.en: to pay attention to a sound
to rest with your eyes closed
a soft seat for two or more people

q: What is the weather like today?
mcq.zh: 「it is raining hard, and it is cold」：下大雨又冷。好天氣是明天。
mcq.en: “it is raining hard, and it is cold.” The nice weather is tomorrow.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「it is raining hard, and it is cold」：下大雨又冷。好天气是明天。

q: Where is Sam today?
mcq.zh: 「I am staying at home」：待在家裡。
mcq.en: “I am staying at home” — at home.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I am staying at home」：待在家里。

q: What is Sam doing with his mom?
mcq.zh: 「I am making a cake with my mom」：一起做蛋糕。看書是之後的事。
mcq.en: “I am making a cake with my mom.” Reading comes after that.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I am making a cake with my mom」：一起做蛋糕。看书是之后的事。

q: Where is the dog?
mcq.zh: 「My dog is sleeping on the sofa」：在沙發上睡覺。
mcq.en: “My dog is sleeping on the sofa” — on the sofa.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「My dog is sleeping on the sofa」：在沙发上睡觉。

q: What is the weather going to be like tomorrow?
mcq.zh: 「Tomorrow the weather is going to be nice」：明天天氣會很好。
mcq.en: “Tomorrow the weather is going to be nice.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「Tomorrow the weather is going to be nice」：明天天气会很好。

s: Today Sam is going to the park with his dog.
tf.zh: ×：「I am not going to the park」，今天不去公園。
tf.en: False: I am not going to the park — not today.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「I am not going to the park」，今天不去公园。

s: After that, he is going to listen to music.
tf.zh: ○：「I am going to read a book and listen to music」。
tf.en: True: I am going to read a book and listen to music.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「I am going to read a book and listen to music」。

s: Tomorrow they are going to go to the park.
tf.zh: ○：「We are going to go to the park!」。
tf.en: True: We are going to go to the park!
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「We are going to go to the park!」。

s.plain: My name is Lily.
s.kana: My name is Lily.

t: On Saturday mornings, I go to the
s.plain: On Saturday mornings, I go to the market with my dad.
s.kana: On Saturday mornings, I go to the market with my dad.

paragraphs.zh: 我叫莉莉。每個星期六早上，我和爸爸去市場。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我叫莉莉。每个星期六早上，我和爸爸去市场。

s.plain: At the market, there is fruit, vegetables, and cheese.
s.kana: At the market, there is fruit, vegetables, and cheese.

s.plain: We buy apples, tomatoes, and carrots.
s.kana: We buy apples, tomatoes, and carrots.

paragraphs.zh: 市場裡有水果、蔬菜和起司。我們買蘋果、番茄和紅蘿蔔。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 市场里有水果、蔬菜和起司。我们买苹果、番茄和红萝卜。

s.plain: A bag of apples costs three dollars.
s.kana: A bag of apples costs three dollars.

s.plain: My dad also buys some cheese for dinner.
s.kana: My dad also buys some cheese for dinner.

paragraphs.zh: 一袋蘋果三塊錢。爸爸還買了一些起司當晚餐。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 一袋苹果三块钱。爸爸还买了一些起司当晚餐。

t: The man at the stand is very
s.plain: The man at the stand is very kind.
s.kana: The man at the stand is very kind.

s.plain: He gives me a banana!
s.kana: He gives me a banana!

paragraphs.zh: 攤位的老闆人很好。他送我一根香蕉！
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 摊位的老板人很好。他送我一根香蕉！

glossary.en: a place where people buy and sell food
a plant you eat, like a carrot
a round red or green fruit

q: Who does Lily go to the market with?
mcq.zh: 「I go to the market with my dad」：和爸爸。
mcq.en: “I go to the market with my dad” — her dad.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I go to the market with my dad」：和爸爸。

q: When do they go to the market?
mcq.zh: 「On Saturday mornings」：星期六早上。
mcq.en: “On Saturday mornings.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「On Saturday mornings」：星期六早上。

q: How much is a bag of apples?
mcq.zh: 「A bag of apples costs three dollars」：三塊錢。
mcq.en: “A bag of apples costs three dollars.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「A bag of apples costs three dollars」：三块钱。

q: Why does her dad buy cheese?
mcq.zh: 「some cheese for dinner」：當晚餐。
mcq.en: “some cheese for dinner” — for dinner.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「some cheese for dinner」：当晚餐。

q: What does the man give Lily?
mcq.zh: 「He gives me a banana!」：一根香蕉。
mcq.en: “He gives me a banana!”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「He gives me a banana!」：一根香蕉。

s: There is no cheese at the market.
tf.zh: ×：「there is fruit, vegetables, and cheese」，有起司。
tf.en: False: there is fruit, vegetables, and cheese.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「there is fruit, vegetables, and cheese」，有起司。

s: They buy tomatoes.
tf.zh: ○：「We buy apples, tomatoes, and carrots」。
tf.en: True: We buy apples, tomatoes, and carrots.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「We buy apples, tomatoes, and carrots」。

s: The man at the stand is not kind.
tf.zh: ×：「The man at the stand is very kind」，老闆人很好。
tf.en: False: The man at the stand is very kind.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「The man at the stand is very kind」，老板人很好。

s.plain: My name is Ken.
s.kana: My name is Ken.

s.plain: I am Japanese, and I live in London.
s.kana: I am Japanese, and I live in London.

paragraphs.zh: 我叫健。我是日本人，住在倫敦。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我叫健。我是日本人，住在伦敦。

t: On Mondays and Wednesdays, I have an English
s.plain: On Mondays and Wednesdays, I have an English class.
s.kana: On Mondays and Wednesdays, I have an English class.

s.plain: The class starts at ten and ends at twelve.
s.kana: The class starts at ten and ends at twelve.

paragraphs.zh: 每週一和週三我有英文課。上課從十點開始，十二點結束。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 每周一和周三我有英文课。上课从十点开始，十二点结束。

s.plain: There are fourteen students in my class.
s.kana: There are fourteen students in my class.

s.plain: Our teacher's name is Ms. Brown.
s.kana: Our teacher's name is Ms. Brown.

s.plain: She speaks slowly, and she is very nice.
s.kana: She speaks slowly, and she is very nice.

paragraphs.zh: 我們班有十四個學生。我們的老師是布朗老師。她說話很慢，人很好。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我们班有十四个学生。我们的老师是布朗老师。她说话很慢，人很好。

s.plain: English is difficult, but I really like my class.
s.kana: English is difficult, but I really like my class.

paragraphs.zh: 英文很難，但是我非常喜歡這門課。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 英文很难，但是我非常喜欢这门课。

glossary.en: a lesson; a group of students

q: Where does Ken live?
mcq.zh: 「I live in London」：住在倫敦。
mcq.en: “I live in London.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I live in London」：住在伦敦。

q: When does he have English class?
mcq.zh: 「On Mondays and Wednesdays, I have an English class」：週一和週三。
mcq.en: “On Mondays and Wednesdays, I have an English class.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「On Mondays and Wednesdays, I have an English class」：周一和周三。

q: What time does the class end?
mcq.zh: 「ends at twelve」：十二點結束。十點是開始的時間。
mcq.en: “ends at twelve” — at twelve. Ten is when it starts.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「ends at twelve」：十二点结束。十点是开始的时间。

q: How many students are in the class?
mcq.zh: 「There are fourteen students in my class」：十四個。
mcq.en: “There are fourteen students in my class.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「There are fourteen students in my class」：十四个。

q: What is Ms. Brown like?
mcq.zh: 「She speaks slowly, and she is very nice」：說話慢、人很好。
mcq.en: “She speaks slowly, and she is very nice.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「She speaks slowly, and she is very nice」：说话慢、人很好。

s: Ken is from China.

s.plain: My name is Grace.
s.kana: My name is Grace.

t: On Sunday, I am going to the
s.plain: On Sunday, I am going to the zoo with my little brother.
s.kana: On Sunday, I am going to the zoo with my little brother.

paragraphs.zh: 我叫葛蕾絲。星期天，我要和弟弟去動物園。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我叫葛蕾丝。星期天，我要和弟弟去动物园。

s.plain: We take the number 5 bus in front of our house.
s.kana: We take the number 5 bus in front of our house.

s.plain: The bus comes at nine thirty.
s.kana: The bus comes at nine thirty.

s.kana: The ride takes thirty minutes.

paragraphs.zh: 我們在家門前搭 5 號公車。公車九點三十分來。車程三十分鐘。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我们在家门前搭 5 号公车。公车九点三十分来。车程三十分钟。

s.plain: At the zoo, there are elephants, giraffes, and pandas.
s.kana: At the zoo, there are elephants, giraffes, and pandas.

s.plain: My brother loves pandas.
s.kana: My brother loves pandas.

paragraphs.zh: 動物園裡有大象、長頸鹿和貓熊。弟弟最喜歡貓熊了。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 动物园里有大象、长颈鹿和猫熊。弟弟最喜欢猫熊了。

t: At noon, we eat sandwiches under a
s.plain: At noon, we eat sandwiches under a tree.
s.kana: At noon, we eat sandwiches under a tree.

s.plain: We go back home at four.
s.kana: We go back home at four.

paragraphs.zh: 中午我們在樹下吃三明治。四點回家。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 中午我们在树下吃三明治。四点回家。

s.plain: He has a headache and a fever.
s.kana: He has a headache and a fever.

paragraphs.zh: 今天早上湯姆覺得不舒服。他頭痛，還發燒。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 今天早上汤姆觉得不舒服。他头痛，还发烧。

t: He does not go to work.
s.plain: He does not go to work.
s.kana: He does not go to work.

s.plain: He calls his boss.
s.kana: He calls his boss.

paragraphs.zh: 他不去上班。他打電話給主管。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 他不去上班。他打电话给主管。

t: In the afternoon, he goes to the
s.plain: In the afternoon, he goes to the doctor.
s.kana: In the afternoon, he goes to the doctor.

t: . Stay in bed and drink a lot of water.”
s.plain: The doctor says, “It's a cold. Stay in bed and drink a lot of water.”
s.kana: The doctor says, “It's a cold. Stay in bed and drink a lot of water.”

paragraphs.zh: 下午他去看醫生。醫生說：「是感冒。請躺在床上休息，多喝水。」
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 下午他去看医生。医生说：「是感冒。请躺在床上休息，多喝水。」

s.plain: Tom takes some medicine and sleeps.
s.kana: Tom takes some medicine and sleeps.

s.plain: In the evening, he feels a little better.

paragraphs.zh-Hans: 汤姆吃了药，睡了一觉。晚上好一点了。

mcq.zh-Hans: 「Stay in bed and drink a lot of water」：躺在床上休息，多喝水。
